# DATA PKT Infra & Geomatics (DATAPKT)

> Drone survey, mapping, GIS and design company based in Gurugram, Haryana, India, founded on 14 September 2020. We survey, map and design for infrastructure projects; we do not build them. Empanelled with the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) in three zones for monthly drone survey work. DIPP-recognised start-up. Legal name: DATAPKT Private Limited.

## What we do
- Drone and DGPS topographic surveys for highways, roads and expressways
- Railway and metro surveys, including Engineering Scale Plans (ESP), yard plans and drainage plans
- Survey and design inputs for Detailed Project Reports (DPRs)
- Drone thermal (infrared) inspection of solar power plants and electrical assets
- Transmission line route surveys and substation site surveys
- Water resources surveys and bathymetry for canals, rivers and reservoirs
- Photogrammetry: orthomosaics, digital terrain and surface models, contours and volumes
- LiDAR survey and classified point clouds
- GIS mapping and data processing, including remote GIS work for clients outside India
- Aerial videography and monthly progress videos for projects

## Sectors
Highways and roads, railways and metro, power and solar, water resources, urban planning, mining, oil and gas, environment, agriculture, archaeology, public safety, manufacturing and wildlife.

## Where we work
Projects across India from our Gurugram office. Remote GIS data processing for clients outside India.
